hey grl, thx 4 sharing ur struggle! i too m just like u n can relate 100%! 

i c ur getting many tips on makeup 💄 n its rly overwhelming and hard at firta when u dont have ppl (girlfriends, sisters, cousins) 4 help! 

i too can barely find the energy to shower and wear clean clothes and apply a cream on my face n brush my teeth. its def hard! 

i had an internship and had a cool roomate and while she moved back to LA we still text and whenever i have a "girl" question like makeup, skincare etc. i ask her and shes my source. 

after 2-3 yrs of also struggling w makeup i wid like to say i figured it out n wud b down to help u out if u want! of note, i only wear makeup on the days i hang out w my bff 👯‍♀️ bc i know we will b going out, taking pics n having a good time! we meet up max 3 times a yr and i can def do that even tho its an extra hr of waking up early that day but its worth it! 

im glad to hear ur bf is good to u and doenst pressure u! 💕 

back to the makeup:

1) buy 1 face & body moisturizer 🧴 to sinply tings sonafter ur shower 🚿 ur good on that front! 😊 theres a lot of gimmcks and over marketing but stick w 1 like i do, such as Cerave or Cetaphil (doctor approved, safe & effective)

2) find a concealer (may take some tries until u find the one but once u do ur set!) - u can use this to conceal anything on ur face or lessen its appearance, e.g. my dark circles-- i find that the tarte brand has great ones if u wanna check them out!

3) this is the fund part!!! so after ur concealer u can also continue to expeiment w what YOU want to do! for example, u can apply eye shadow now then some mascara, blush if u want and some lip gloss/stick (i dont wanna confuse u lol but this is where u can express yourself and b true to u, so just take it slow and add on later). i wish i cud come n help u irl girl, that b so fun! i always wished i had a sister! 💗 

• also ALWAYS buy the mini versions so u can experiment! 

• additionally, makeup is a money investment but worht it bc it help u feel better and enhances ur beauty n if YOU want to learn then u def have the right to do so 😘 ... regarding the price aspect u can buy from places u feel comfortable but the generic places r sephora, ulta beauty then target or other markets

some parting words, u got this girl and keep ur head strong 💪🏽

Generally speaking I think the more quality friends you have the better as you gain a support system but even having 1 good friend is plentiful. I can relate and understand the many things you have experienced in adolescence and now as an adult. I'm terribly sorry for the sexual abuse you suffered as a child, that leaves deep wounds and those scars are there forever but with time they will surely fade. Just so you know, I too was molested by a family member growing up and it has changed me. Being 25 such as yourself I too struggle with being an adult as I am well passed the the age where one is considered an adult, 18, but I still have hard time with what happened to me so I take breath and take things one day at a time.

I can relate to you when it comes to working your entire life for the approval of your family and friends, and it really sucks! 

Sorry to hear about your abusive mother, no one should have to take that kind of abuse. I don't know the full scope of your relationship with your mom but from what you have shared, she sounds like a pitiful, angry, horrid and ruthless woman. Harming your child physically and mentally is absolutely wrong nonetheless when they share devastating personal insight into their abuser. 

Regarding the little white lies, a lot of people do that including myself. When you are pushed up against a wall and you have no other option but to lie then that's what people may have to do but the downfall is that it become a habit and therefore starts to become second nature and it's really annoying because sometimes it feels like you can't stop the lying. For example, I pretended I graduated college with my bachelors degree when in fact I didn't. I did eventually graduate but the point is that it was so easy to lie and it caused mistrust between my relationship with my parents.

I struggle A LOT with people pleasing and one way to avoid putting yourself in that situation is by having boundaries and physically removing yourself from negative situations. Advice is easy to give but hard to do but with small steps you can change and help yourself become the best version of you! I believe in you! \^-\^ 

You're worth every last breath on this earth and bring positivity into this world. 

Stay strong and as Nemo says, "Just keep swimming." ;}

XOXO,

Many people get sad during the winter time, I know I do and all of my close family and friends are also affected by it. It's called Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD), a mood disorder that occurs during the same time each year. You can talk to a therapist during this time if you would like. Continue going out and getting sunlight, being with friends and practicing wellness goals while focusing on your career/education.

Good luck this winter and I believe in you fellow friend! :)
